children.name: column
children.description: Physical column name for this field on an rdb source. Defaults to the field name via columnNamingStrategy.

children.name: db.indexed
children.description: When true, suppress the @filterable-without-index Loader warning (the field is indexed by other means).

children.name: dbColumnType
children.description: Physical DB column-type override (ADR-0013 escape hatch). Legal values are uuid | jsonb | timestamp_with_tz, each legal only on a specific logical field subtype (uuid/jsonb on field.string, timestamp_with_tz on field.timestamp). The logical field type and its native binding are unchanged.

children.name: storage
children.description: Storage strategy for an object-typed field (set with @objectRef). "flattened" expands the nested value into prefixed columns on the parent table. "jsonb" stores the structured value in a single jsonb column (supports isArray=true for arrays of values). "subdocument" is a hint for document-store codegen targets and emits no Postgres column.

children.name: autoSet
children.description: Auto-set semantics for timestamp-like fields: 'onCreate' stamps on insert, 'onUpdate' stamps on every write.

children.name: table
children.description: Physical SQL table name for source.rdb @kind: "table" (default). FR-016: Defaults from the source's bare structural `name` via the project's columnNamingStrategy when omitted, then from the owning entity's name. Pre-1.0 legacy spelling for view/materializedView/storedProc/tableFunction kinds during the transition; canonical-serializer rewrites to the kind-matching alias.

children.name: view
children.description: Physical SQL view name for source.rdb @kind: "view". Same internal slot as @table.

children.name: materializedView
children.description: Physical SQL materialized-view name for source.rdb @kind: "materializedView". Same internal slot as @table.

children.name: proc
children.description: Physical SQL stored-procedure name for source.rdb @kind: "storedProc". Same internal slot as @table.

children.name: function
children.description: Physical SQL table-function name for source.rdb @kind: "tableFunction". Same internal slot as @table.

children.name: kind
children.description: The kind of database object this source represents: table (default, writable), view, materializedView, storedProc, or tableFunction. Non-table kinds are read-only.

children.name: role
children.description: Role this source plays when an object has multiple sources: primary (default, system of record), replica, index, cache, publish, or mirror.

children.name: schema
children.description: Optional database schema name (e.g. 'catalog', 'public'). Postgres defaults to 'public'; SQLite rejects any non-default value.

children.name: parameterRef
children.description: FR-015: name or FQN of an object.value describing the input shape of this source's callable interface. Permitted on @kind: "storedProc" / "tableFunction"; rejected on non-callable kinds (table / view / materializedView). Field children of the referenced object.value become the call-site parameter list in declaration order. Symmetric with template.@payloadRef in FR-004 — the typed-input pattern reuses object.value rather than minting a new parameter.* node type.
